requirements.label: calculus
requirements.title: Calculus sequence (prerequisite; see manualCheck)

rule.manualCheck: The page states that single-variable calculus is not a requirement of the minor and is a prerequisite for some listed courses, yet these calculus options are printed in the requirement list. Confirm with the department whether these courses count toward the minor. The MAT 125 + MAT 130 alternative is garbled on the page (MAT 130 is followed by a trailing comma); it is modeled as an allOf of MAT 125 and MAT 130 as printed.

requirements.sourceText: MAT 131 - Calculus I 4 credits AND MAT 132 - Calculus II 4 credits OR MAT 125 - Calculus A 3 credits MAT 130 - Trigonometry and Logarithms 1 credit, MAT 125 - Calculus A Credits: 3 credits AND MAT 126 - Calculus B 3 credits AND MAT 127 - Calculus C 3 credits OR AMS 151 - Applied Calculus I 3 credits AND AMS 161 - Applied Calculus II 3 credits OR MAT141 AND MAT 142 OR MAT 171

requirements.label: linear-algebra
requirements.title: Linear algebra
requirements.sourceText: MAT 211 - Introduction to Linear Algebra 3 credits OR AMS 210 - Applied Linear Algebra 3 credits OR MAT 308 - Differential Equations with Linear Algebra 4 credits

requirements.label: calculus-iii
requirements.title: Calculus III
requirements.sourceText: MAT 203 - Calculus III with Applications 4 credits OR AMS 261 - Applied Calculus III 4 credits OR MAT 307 - Multivariable Calculus with Linear Algebra 4 credits

requirements.label: advanced-linear-algebra
requirements.title: Advanced algebra / linear algebra
requirements.sourceText: MAT 310 - Linear Algebra 4 credits OR MAT 312 - Applied Algebra 3 credits OR MAT 313 - Abstract Algebra 3 credits OR MAT 315 - Advanced Linear Algebra 4 credits

requirements.label: analysis
requirements.title: Analysis
requirements.sourceText: MAT 319 - Foundations of Analysis 4 credits OR MAT 320 - Introduction to Analysis 4 credits OR MAT 341 - Applied Real Analysis 3 credits OR MAT 342 - Applied Complex Analysis 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Upper-division MAT electives
requirements.sourceText: Three additional MAT courses numbered 300 or higher (excluding 475)

policies.sourceText: All courses used to fulfill the requirements for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher
All courses used to fulfill the requirements for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher

notes.text: The minor is intended to emphasize upper-division work in mathematics. Single-variable calculus and MAT 200 - Logic, Language and Proof are prerequisites for some listed courses and are not included in the requirements as stated on the page.
Some or all of the requirements may be fulfilled by an appropriate score on the Mathematics Placement Exam, by AP credit, or by comparable means.
